ai_summary: This document confirms that Amarjothi Spinning Mills Limited has complied with SEBI Regulation 74(5) for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, regarding the dematerialization of shares. The accompanying certificate from their Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, Cameo Corporate Services Limited, verifies that all shares received for dematerialization were processed, mutilated, cancelled, and registered with depositories within the stipulated time. This indicates routine regulatory compliance with no apparent red flags or adverse material impacts, ensuring proper handling of investor share conversions.
